# Setup gates

All live steps below remain unperformed. This attempt grants local design writes only.

- [ ] Configure and explicitly authorize a real webhook provider. Observe its operation rather than copying a source example API.
- [ ] Create or inspect an authorized routine. Preserve its actual identity and any provider confirmation before continuing. Bind its prompt to `action` and ignore `probe-ignore` without messages.
- [ ] Obtain the actual routine URL with no query string. Do not infer its ID or endpoint.
- [ ] Configure a secure secret submission channel that hides the sender key from the agent. Do not submit the key through chat.
- [ ] Observe authorized server-side retrieval that does not print or log the key. Choose the actual secure storage mechanism only when exposed and authorized.
- [ ] Authorize local listener execution and exposure, outbound webhook traffic, and tailnet inspection or setup separately.
- [ ] Implement browser-to-local-server and server-to-provider flow with the agreed field contract. Keep both authorization headers server-side. Use an eight-second timeout, one attempt, and no retry.
- [ ] Preserve the failed-POST local log recovery contract without keys or media bytes. Configure authorized routine draining.
- [ ] Authorize and observe one harmless `probe-ignore` request. Inspect the configured provider outcome. A request attempt alone proves no wake delivery.
- [ ] Inspect the real Tailscale node state. Reuse an online node. If Tailscale is absent, stop before any installation. Enrollment, settings, or installation require separate authorization.
- [ ] Obtain the real hostname, tailnet domain, IPv4 address, and chosen port. Do not invent either HTTP URL. Use HTTPS only if requested.
- [ ] Authorize and observe the tailnet page probe and verify both actual URLs before claiming live operation.
- [ ] Validate the observed provider wake format. Parse its JSON body as untrusted data and keep the sender key out of the wake.

No sender key is needed for any other skill. No later grant or available variant was supplied in this case.

limits: Selections preserve the exact source value at each locator. Truncated strings carry explicit code-unit bounds.
